en_title: AMD FSR 4.1 Is Finally Coming to Xbox Series X, Rivaling PS5's QSSR
subtitle: 精简模型，扩大支持
opus_summary: AMD宣布精简FSR 4.1模型，将支持较低性能硬件，并即将首次登陆XBOX Series X。目前尚无明确上线时间，下一代FSR也已确认将登陆Project Helix。

paragraphs.en: AMD FSR 4.1 has been a massive improvement for Team Red's AI upscaling tech, but it was previously only available on Radeon 7000 and 9000 graphics cards. But today, AMD has announced that the technology will now be coming to more devices like the Xbox Series X.
paragraphs.cn: FSR 4.1让AMD的AI超分辨率技术有了大幅提升，但此前仅支持Radeon 7000和9000系列显卡。今天，AMD宣布，这项技术将支持更多设备，包括XBOX Series X。

paragraphs.en: Just like DLSS, FSR 4.1 uses AI to take a lower resolution input image and upscale it back up to native resolution, but because it's more computationally expensive than FSR 3, support for lower-powered hardware has been slow. However, thanks to the ongoing partnership with Sony (dubbed Project Amethyst), AMD has been making huge strides to make it run better on weaker devices.
paragraphs.cn: 与DLSS一样，FSR 4.1利用AI将输入的低分辨率图像提升至原生分辨率。不过，它对算力的要求高于FSR 3，因此适配较低性能硬件的进展一直比较缓慢。但通过与索尼持续开展的Project Amethyst合作，AMD在改善这项技术在较低性能设备上的运行表现方面取得了长足进展。

paragraphs.en: AMD announced the widened support in a video , and will bring the upscaling tech to RDNA 2 graphics cards like the 6800 XT , along with Z2-powered handhelds like the Xbox Ally X20 . What stopped AMD from bringing this model to these older and less-powerful chips was that it was harder to run, which eliminated some of the benefit of even using upscaling. But, according to AMD SVP of Gaming and Graphics Jack Huynh, AMD was able to trim down the model to make it efficient on less powerful hardware that might not have the same suite of AI accelerators that RDNA 4 graphics cards do.
paragraphs.cn: AMD在一段视频中宣布扩大支持范围，将为6800 XT等RDNA 2显卡，以及XBOX Ally X20等搭载Z2芯片的掌机带来这项超分辨率技术。此前，这个模型运行起来负担较重，会抵消超分辨率技术带来的部分收益，因此AMD一直未能将它适配到这些较老、性能较低的芯片上。不过，AMD游戏与图形业务高级副总裁Jack Huynh表示，AMD成功精简了模型，使其能够在性能较低的硬件上高效运行，即便这些硬件可能没有配备RDNA 4显卡那样的一整套AI加速器。

paragraphs.en: This comes just a couple weeks after AMD and Sony did the same exact thing with PSSR 2 , trimming it down to a new model, dubbed QSSR , for the base PS5. QSSR does offer much better upscaling than FSR 2-based solution the PS5 had before, so I can only imagine this slimmer FSR 4.1 will have a similar effect for the Xbox Ally X.
paragraphs.cn: 就在几周前，AMD和索尼刚刚对PSSR 2做了同样的处理，将其精简为名叫QSSR的新模型，供基础版PS5使用。相比PS5此前基于FSR 2的方案，QSSR的超分辨率效果确实好了很多，因此我想，这个精简版FSR 4.1也会为XBOX Ally X带来类似的改善。

paragraphs.en: But more importantly, this update will also allow FSR 4.1 to come to the Xbox Series X for the first time. The new upscaling model isn't out yet on Xbox, but AMD says it is 'coming soon,' although it's not clear what 'soon' means there. Hopefully, Microsoft is able to get it into a patch before Grand Theft Auto 6 launches next month.
paragraphs.cn: 但更重要的是，这次更新还将让FSR 4.1首次登陆XBOX Series X。新的超分辨率模型尚未在XBOX上推出，但AMD表示它「即将上线」，只是这里的「即将」究竟指多久，目前还不清楚。希望微软能在下个月《GTA6》发售前，通过补丁加入这项技术。

paragraphs.en: After all, there have been plenty of concerns that Rockstar's next crime epic is going to be extremely hard to run for the base consoles , and a better upscaler just means better performance and improved image quality. But even if this FSR 4.1 update misses GTA's launch date, Xbox is going to continue working with AMD to bring upscaling to its consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 毕竟，很多人担心基础版主机运行Rockstar的下一部犯罪题材大作会极其吃力，而更好的超分辨率技术能带来更好的性能和画质。不过，即便这次FSR 4.1更新赶不上《侠盗猎车手》新作的发售，XBOX也将继续与AMD合作，为旗下主机引入超分辨率技术。

paragraphs.en: In the same video Xbox CTO Scott Van Vliet confirmed that AMD's next-generation FSR 'Diamond' would be coming to Project Helix. And now that Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has confirmed that Helix would be a whole 'family of devices,' I hope that this fancy new upscaling finds its way to all of them, no matter how powerful they are.
paragraphs.cn: 在同一段视频中，XBOX首席技术官Scott Van Vliet确认，AMD的下一代FSR「Diamond」将登陆Project Helix。如今，XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma已确认Helix将是一个完整的「设备家族」，我希望这项亮眼的新超分辨率技术能够覆盖其中所有设备，无论它们的性能如何。
